Content: Ownly is a food-delivery platform operated by Rapido. It charges restaurants no commission and adds no platform, packaging or surge fees, so the customer's final bill is lower. It launched in Bengaluru and is now live in Hyderabad, including at the Gachibowli address this study audited.

Section: Why the obvious question is the wrong one
Content: Discounts reliably produce trial, so 'will anyone try it' is not worth asking. Foodpanda India fell from about 200,000 daily orders in Aug 2018 to about 5,000 by mid-2019 - a 97.5% collapse in roughly ten months - and suspended food delivery. Uber Eats India and Amazon Food also exited. No challenger in the Indian record has demonstrated post-subsidy retention.

How large and durable must Ownly's price advantage be to break Swiggy/Zomato lock-in in Gachibowli, and what restaurant coverage, discovery and delivery experience are required so that price-led trial becomes repeat usage?

Each of SIX pre-registered Bengaluru playbook elements gets KEEP (replicate as in Bengaluru), ADAPT (keep with localisation or operational change) or DROP/DEPRIORITIZE (don't lead Hyderabad GTM with it). The six elements are fixed: transparent lower price; no/low fees; Rapido cross-sell; game/first-order reward; local restaurant supply; delivery reliability proposition.
Evidence label: PRE-REGISTERED RULE, fixed 2026-09-16 before any data

Section: Decision level 2 - the overall Hyderabad call
Content: REPLICATE, ADAPT, LOCALIZE or INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE, decided by counting the six element verdicts against four guardrails (G1-G4) and the H0 result. The call is labelled PROVISIONAL when two or more elements rest on LOW confidence.
Evidence label: PRE-REGISTERED RULE, fixed 2026-09-16 before any data

Section: What this study does NOT decide
Content: Not whether to enter - Ownly is already live at the audited address. Not restaurant-side economics, and not rider supply.

Survey n=40 in the Gachibowli catchment (124 responses received, 87 passing quality checks). Price audit: 4 matched baskets across a 10-restaurant frame, one drop point, ONE PRICED SLOT of two planned. 836 public documents across 16 months. Interviews: 1 documented transcript plus team-reported interviews, count not recorded. Fake-door experiment designed, powered and NOT FIELDED (0 events).

Adults 20-35 ordering food online into the Gachibowli catchment. Convenience sample, not a probability sample. Results describe this sample and are directional for the catchment. Every proportion carries a 95% Wilson interval; the audit median carries a bootstrap interval.

Section: Known limits that bind the conclusion
Content: Two of four guardrails (G2 fulfilment failure, G4 promo dependency) CANNOT BE EVALUATED because their source questions (A3, A2) are absent from the live instrument. The audit priced only one of two planned slots. The trier base is 2 respondents. These are the reasons the overall call is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE rather than a verdict.
